item.title: The ‘European’ Jolla Phone Is an Anti-Big-Tech Smartphone
item.description: The Finnish company Jolla is back with the Linux-powered Jolla Phone. It’s being positioned as an antidote to the US-dominated smartphone status quo of Android and iOS.
